[RTCT.6.8] **Cache caps.** `cache_cap` (field 15, max live
cache keys — `uint32` ≤ 2³¹−1 per [RTCT.6.7.7]) and `cache_bytes_cap`
(field 16, cache value byte capacity — **`uint64` ≤ 2⁶³−1**: a byte
capacity warrants 64-bit headroom where a count cap does not, the high
bit staying reserved to mirror [RTCT.6.7.7]) bound the engine-owned cache
([LSTO.4.7]) in the `realtime` / `constspace` slab budget, enforced
per [RTCT.7.1] with breach ⇒ `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_BREACH`. A value over its
bound is `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_INVALID`.
